```{r setup, include=FALSE}
savefig <- function(
  filename,
  height = 10,
  width = (1 + sqrt(5)) / 2 * height,
  type = c("eps", "pdf", "jpg", "png"),
  pointsize = 10,
  family = "Helvetica",
  sublines = 0,
  toplines = 0,
  leftlines = 0,
  res = 300
) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  filename <- paste0(filename, ".", type)

  if (type == "eps") {
    postscript(
      file = filename,
      horizontal = FALSE,
      width = width / 2.54,
      height = height / 2.54,
      pointsize = pointsize,
      family = family,
      onefile = FALSE,
      print.it = FALSE
    )
  } else if (type == "pdf") {
    pdf(
      file = filename,
      width = width / 2.54,
      height = height / 2.54,
      pointsize = pointsize,
      family = family,
      onefile = TRUE
    )
  } else if (type == "jpg") {
    jpeg(
      filename = filename,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      res = res,
      quality = 100,
      units = "cm"
    )
  } else if (type == "png") {
    png(
      filename = filename,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      res = res,
      units = "cm"
    )
  }

  par(
    mgp = c(2.2, 0.45, 0),
    tcl = -0.4,
    mar = c(
      3.2 + sublines + 0.25 * (sublines > 0),
      3.5 + leftlines,
      1 + toplines,
      1
    ) + 0.1,
    pch = 1
  )

  invisible()
}

savepdf <- function(...) {
  savefig(..., type = "pdf")
}

method_key <- tribble(
  ~order_selection_method, ~internal_method, ~Method,

as_method_factor <- function(x) {
  factor(x, levels = method_levels)
}

attach_method <- function(data) {
  data |>
    rename(internal_method = method) |>
    inner_join(method_key, by = c("order_selection_method", "internal_method")) |>
    mutate(Method = as_method_factor(Method))
}

format_best_html <- function(x, colour) {
  shown <- sprintf("%.4f", x)
  is_best <- round(x, 4) == min(round(x, 4), na.rm = TRUE)
  shown[is_best] <- kableExtra::cell_spec(
    shown[is_best],
    color = colour,
    bold = TRUE
  )
  shown
}
```

```{r}
plot_FACF_topright <- function(rho,Blueline,ci,...){
  # Define suitable lwd for plotting
  nlags <- length(rho)
  if(nlags <= 30){
    lwd_1 <- 8
  }else if(nlags <= 50){
    lwd_1 <- 6
  }else if(nlags <= 150){
    lwd_1 <- 4
  }else{
    lwd_1 <- 3
  }
  
  # Check if any additional plotting parameters are present
  arguments <- list(...)
  if(!"xlab" %in% names(arguments))  arguments$xlab <- "Lag"
  if(!"ylab" %in% names(arguments))  arguments$ylab <- "Autocorrelation"
  if(!"ylim" %in% names(arguments))  arguments$ylim <- c(0,max(rho)*1.5)
  if(!"lwd"  %in% names(arguments))   arguments$lwd  <- lwd_1
  if(!"las"  %in% names(arguments))   arguments$las  <- 1
  if(!"lend" %in% names(arguments))   arguments$lend  <- 2
  if(!"yaxs" %in% names(arguments))   arguments$yaxs  <- "i"
  if(!"xaxs" %in% names(arguments))   arguments$xaxs  <- "i"
  if(!"main" %in% names(arguments))  arguments$main  <- ""
  if(!"xlim" %in% names(arguments))  arguments$xlim  <- c(0,length(rho)+1)
  arguments$x = seq(1,length(rho),by = 1)
  arguments$y = rho
  arguments$type = "h"
  
  do.call(graphics::plot,arguments)
  grid(lty = 1)
  do.call(graphics::lines,arguments)
  graphics::lines(x = arguments$x, 
                  y = arguments$y,
                  type = arguments$type, 
                  col = "lightgrey", 
                  lwd = arguments$lwd-2, 
                  lend = 2);
  blue_color <- "#0073C2FF"
  graphics::abline(h = Blueline,col = blue_color,lwd = 4, lty = 2)
  graphics::legend(x = "topright",
                   legend = c(paste("i.i.d. bound (",ci*100," % conf.)",sep="")),
                   col = blue_color,
                   lty = 2,
                   lwd = 4)
  box()
}
```


# England and Wales fertility

## Data and preprocessing

```{r data-functions}
raw <- read.table("Empirical Study/Fertility Data/asfrRR.txt", skip = 2, header = TRUE) |>
  filter(Code == "GBRTENW", Age %in% 15:49) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Age, names_from = Year, values_from = ASFR) |>
  column_to_rownames("Age") |>
  as.matrix()

exposure <- read.table("Empirical Study/Fertility Data/exposRR.txt", skip = 2, header = TRUE) |>
  filter(Code == "GBRTENW", Age %in% 15:49) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Age, names_from = Year, values_from = Exposure) |>
  column_to_rownames("Age") |>
  as.matrix()

ew <- demogdata(
  data = raw,
  pop = exposure,
  ages = 15:49,
  years = as.integer(colnames(raw)),
  type = "fertility",
  label = "England and Wales",
  name = "ASFR",
  lambda = 0.4
)

smooth <- smooth.demogdata(ew, method = "cspline")$rate[[1]]

fertility_data <- list(
  `England and Wales` = list(
    raw = (raw^0.4 - 1) / 0.4,
    smooth = (smooth^0.4 - 1) / 0.4
  )
)
```

## Forecast

```{r run-models}
dir.create("Empirical Study/results", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

forecast_results <- list()

for (country in names(fertility_data)) {
  result_path <- file.path(
    "Empirical Study/results",
    "england_wales_fertility_forecast.rds"
  )

  if (!params$rerun_models && file.exists(result_path)) {
    result <- readRDS(result_path)
  } else {
    result <- unified_pipeline(
      X = fertility_data[[country]]$smooth,
      X_eval = fertility_data[[country]]$raw,
      h_max = 10,
      train_ratio = 0.6,
      valid_ratio = 0.2,
      alpha_set = c(0.2, 0.05),
      window_types = "expanding",
      p_max = 5,
      q_max = 5,
      Npc = 1,
      B = 399,
      m_const = 0.75,
      far_pve = 0.95,
      fracdiff_trim = 20,
      seed = 123,
      far_benchmark_d = 1,
      order_selection_method = "both",
      cv_order_window_type = "expanding",
      memory_cov_type = "sample"
    )

    saveRDS(result, result_path)
  }

  forecast_results[[country]] <- result
}

for (country in names(forecast_results)) {
  result <- forecast_results[[country]]
  benchmark <- result$error_detail |>
    filter(method == "far") |>
    arrange(order_selection_method, t0)

  ic <- benchmark |> filter(order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic")
  cv <- benchmark |> filter(order_selection_method == "cv_expanding")

  stopifnot(nrow(ic) == nrow(cv))
  stopifnot(identical(ic$t0, cv$t0))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ic))) {
    stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(ic$error[[i]], cv$error[[i]])))
  }
}
```

### Metrics


```{r metric-functions}
summarise_point_metrics <- function(result, fitted_data, observed_data) {
  error_data <- result$error_detail |>
    attach_method()

  metric_rows <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(error_data))) {
    error_matrix <- error_data$error[[i]]
    target_columns <- error_data$t0[i] + seq_len(ncol(error_matrix))
    forecast_matrix <-
      fitted_data[, target_columns, drop = FALSE] + error_matrix
    evaluation_error <-
      forecast_matrix - observed_data[, target_columns, drop = FALSE]

    metric_rows[[i]] <- tibble(
      Method = error_data$Method[i],
      h = seq_len(ncol(evaluation_error)),
      squared_error = colSums(evaluation_error^2),
      absolute_error = colSums(abs(evaluation_error)),
      n = nrow(evaluation_error)
    )
  }

  bind_rows(metric_rows) |>
    group_by(Method, h) |>
    summarise(
      RMSE = sqrt(sum(squared_error) / sum(n)),
      MAE = sum(absolute_error) / sum(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

summarise_interval_metrics <- function(result, fitted_data, observed_data) {
  error_data <- result$error_detail |>
    attach_method()
  calibration_data <- result$calibration_detail |>
    attach_method()
  metric_rows <- list()
  row_index <- 0L

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(error_data))) {
    error_matrix <- error_data$error[[i]]
    target_columns <- error_data$t0[i] + seq_len(ncol(error_matrix))
    forecast_matrix <-
      fitted_data[, target_columns, drop = FALSE] + error_matrix
    evaluation_error <-
      forecast_matrix - observed_data[, target_columns, drop = FALSE]
    method_calibration <- calibration_data |>
      filter(Method == error_data$Method[i])

    for (j in seq_len(nrow(method_calibration))) {
      alpha_now <- method_calibration$alpha[j]
      gamma_now <- method_calibration$gamma[[j]]
      zeta_now <- method_calibration$zeta[[j]]

      for (h_now in seq_len(ncol(evaluation_error))) {
        error_now <- evaluation_error[, h_now]
        half_width <- zeta_now[h_now] * as.numeric(gamma_now[[h_now]])
        keep <- is.finite(error_now) & is.finite(half_width)
        error_now <- error_now[keep]
        half_width <- half_width[keep]
        interval_score <-
          2 * half_width +
          (2 / alpha_now) * pmax(abs(error_now) - half_width, 0)

        row_index <- row_index + 1L
        metric_rows[[row_index]] <- tibble(
          Method = error_data$Method[i],
          alpha = alpha_now,
          h = h_now,
          covered = sum(abs(error_now) <= half_width),
          score_sum = sum(interval_score),
          n = length(error_now)
        )
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(metric_rows) |>
    group_by(Method, alpha, h) |>
    summarise(
      covered = sum(covered),
      score_sum = sum(score_sum),
      n = sum(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      ECP = covered / n,
      CPD = abs(ECP - (1 - alpha)),
      Score = score_sum / n
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(Method, alpha, h, ECP, CPD, Score)
}

summarise_interval_metrics_by_rule <- function(result, fitted_data, observed_data) {
  error_data <- result$error_detail |>
    attach_method()
  calibration_data <- result$calibration_detail |>
    attach_method()
  metric_rows <- list()
  row_index <- 0L

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(error_data))) {
    error_matrix <- error_data$error[[i]]
    t0_now <- error_data$t0[i]
    target_columns <- t0_now + seq_len(ncol(error_matrix))
    forecast_matrix <-
      fitted_data[, target_columns, drop = FALSE] + error_matrix
    observed_matrix <- observed_data[, target_columns, drop = FALSE]
    method_calibration <- calibration_data |>
      filter(Method == error_data$Method[i])

    for (j in seq_len(nrow(method_calibration))) {
      alpha_now <- method_calibration$alpha[j]
      gamma_now <- method_calibration$gamma[[j]]
      zeta_now <- method_calibration$zeta[[j]]
      Q_now <- method_calibration$Q_hat[[j]]
      aci_Q_now <- method_calibration$aci_Q[[j]]

      for (h_now in seq_len(ncol(forecast_matrix))) {
        gamma_h <- as.numeric(gamma_now[[h_now]])
        f_h <- forecast_matrix[, h_now]
        y_h <- observed_matrix[, h_now]

        bands <- list(
          grid_sd = list(
            lower = f_h - zeta_now[h_now] * gamma_h,
            upper = f_h + zeta_now[h_now] * gamma_h
          ),
          scores = conformal_interval(f_h, gamma_h, Q_now[h_now]),
          aci = conformal_interval(
            f_h, gamma_h, aci_Q_now[as.character(t0_now), h_now]
          )
        )

        for (rule_now in names(bands)) {
          lower <- bands[[rule_now]]$lower
          upper <- bands[[rule_now]]$upper
          keep <- is.finite(y_h) & is.finite(lower) & is.finite(upper)
          if (!any(keep)) next

          row_index <- row_index + 1L
          metric_rows[[row_index]] <- tibble(
            Rule = rule_now,
            Method = error_data$Method[i],
            alpha = alpha_now,
            h = h_now,
            covered = sum(y_h[keep] >= lower[keep] & y_h[keep] <= upper[keep]),
            score_sum = sum(interval_score_cells(
              y_h[keep], lower[keep], upper[keep], alpha_now
            )),
            n = sum(keep)
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(metric_rows) |>
    group_by(Rule, Method, alpha, h) |>
    summarise(
      covered = sum(covered),
      score_sum = sum(score_sum),
      n = sum(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      ECP = covered / n,
      CPD = abs(ECP - (1 - alpha)),
      Score = score_sum / n,
      Rule = factor(Rule, levels = c("grid_sd", "scores", "aci"))
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(Rule, Method, alpha, h, covered, score_sum, n, ECP, CPD, Score)
}

summarise_wis <- function(point, interval) {
  interval |>
    group_by(Method, h) |>
    summarise(
      K = n_distinct(alpha),
      weighted_interval = sum((alpha / 2) * Score),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    left_join(point |> dplyr::select(Method, h, MAE), by = c("Method", "h")) |>
    mutate(WIS = (0.5 * MAE + weighted_interval) / (K + 0.5)) |>
    dplyr::select(Method, h, WIS)
}

metric_results <- list()

for (country in names(forecast_results)) {
  result <- forecast_results[[country]]
  point <- summarise_point_metrics(
    result,
    fitted_data = fertility_data[[country]]$smooth,
    observed_data = fertility_data[[country]]$raw
  )
  interval <- summarise_interval_metrics_by_rule(
    result,
    fitted_data = fertility_data[[country]]$smooth,
    observed_data = fertility_data[[country]]$raw
  ) |>
    mutate(Rule = factor(recode(as.character(Rule), grid_sd = "SR", scores = "NS", aci = "AC"), levels = c("SR", "NS", "AC"))) |>
    dplyr::select(Rule, Method, alpha, h, ECP, CPD, Score)
  wis <- bind_rows(
    summarise_wis(point, interval |> filter(Rule == "SR")) |> mutate(Rule = "SR", .before = 1),
    summarise_wis(point, interval |> filter(Rule == "NS")) |> mutate(Rule = "NS", .before = 1),
    summarise_wis(point, interval |> filter(Rule == "AC")) |> mutate(Rule = "AC", .before = 1)
  ) |>
    mutate(Rule = factor(Rule, levels = c("SR", "NS", "AC")))

  metric_results[[country]] <- list(
    point = point,
    interval = interval,
    wis = wis
  )
}

point_metric_list <- list()
interval_metric_list <- list()
wis_metric_list <- list()

for (country in names(metric_results)) {
  point_metric_list[[country]] <- metric_results[[country]]$point |>
    mutate(Country = country, .before = 1)
  interval_metric_list[[country]] <- metric_results[[country]]$interval |>
    mutate(Country = country, .before = 1)
  wis_metric_list[[country]] <- metric_results[[country]]$wis |>
    mutate(Country = country, .before = 1)
}

point_metrics <- bind_rows(point_metric_list)
interval_metrics <- bind_rows(interval_metric_list)
wis_metrics <- bind_rows(wis_metric_list)

point_ratios <- point_metrics |>
  left_join(
    point_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Country, h, benchmark_RMSE = RMSE, benchmark_MAE = MAE),
    by = c("Country", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    `RMSPE ratio` = RMSE / benchmark_RMSE,
    `MAPE ratio` = MAE / benchmark_MAE
  )

interval_ratios <- interval_metrics |>
  left_join(
    interval_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Country, Rule, alpha, h, benchmark_Score = Score),
    by = c("Country", "Rule", "alpha", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(`Score ratio` = Score / benchmark_Score)

wis_ratios <- wis_metrics |>
  left_join(
    wis_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Country, Rule, h, benchmark_WIS = WIS),
    by = c("Country", "Rule", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(`WIS ratio` = WIS / benchmark_WIS)
```

### Point accuracy

```{r point-wis-table}
point_metrics |>
  filter(Country == "England and Wales") |>
  group_by(Country, h) |>
  mutate(
    RMSPE = format_best_html(RMSE, "red"),
    MAPE = format_best_html(MAE, "blue")
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Method = recode(
      as.character(Method),
      `Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))` = "Benchmark"
    ),
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Benchmark", "Functional IC", "CV"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Country, h, Method, RMSPE, MAPE) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Method,
    values_from = c(RMSPE, MAPE),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Method}"
  ) |>
  arrange(Country, h) |>
  kable(
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    col.names = c(
      "Country", "h",
      "Bench.", "IC", "CV",
      "Bench.", "IC", "CV"
    ),
    caption = "Fertility point forecast accuracy over all ten horizons"
  ) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "RMSPE" = 3, "MAPE" = 3))
```

```{r fertility-ratio-plots, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
fertility_point_ratio_data <- point_ratios |>
  filter(
    Country == "England and Wales",
    Method != "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Method, h, `RMSPE ratio`, `MAPE ratio`) |>
  pivot_longer(
    ends_with("ratio"),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Ratio"
  ) |>
```

### Forecast plot

```{r forecast-band-functions}
extract_forecast_bands <- function(result, x, observed_x, country, alpha_show = c(0.20, 0.05)) {
  forecast_rows <- result$error_detail |>
    attach_method()

  forecast_rows$n_horizons <- integer(nrow(forecast_rows))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(forecast_rows))) {
    forecast_rows$n_horizons[i] <- ncol(forecast_rows$error[[i]])
  }

  forecast_rows <- forecast_rows |>
    filter(n_horizons >= 10)

  latest_t0 <- forecast_rows |>
    distinct(t0, Method) |>
    dplyr::count(t0) |>
    filter(n == length(method_levels)) |>
    summarise(t0 = max(t0)) |>
    pull(t0)

  calibration_rows <- result$calibration_detail |>
    attach_method() |>
    filter(alpha %in% alpha_show)

  band_rows <- list()
  row_index <- 0L

  for (method_now in method_levels) {
    method_forecast <- forecast_rows |>
      filter(t0 == latest_t0, Method == method_now) |>
      slice(1)

    error_matrix <- method_forecast$error[[1]]

    fitted_matrix <- x[, latest_t0 + seq_len(10), drop = FALSE]
    observed_matrix <- observed_x[, latest_t0 + seq_len(10), drop = FALSE]
    forecast_matrix <-
      fitted_matrix + error_matrix[, seq_len(10), drop = FALSE]

    method_calibration <- calibration_rows |>
      filter(Method == method_now) |>
      arrange(desc(alpha))

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(method_calibration))) {
      alpha_now <- method_calibration$alpha[i]
      gamma_now <- method_calibration$gamma[[i]]
      zeta_now <- method_calibration$zeta[[i]]

      for (h_now in seq_len(10)) {
        half_width <- zeta_now[h_now] * as.numeric(gamma_now[[h_now]])
        row_index <- row_index + 1L
        band_rows[[row_index]] <- tibble(
            Country = country,
            Method = as_method_factor(method_now),
            `Interval level` = factor(
              scales::percent(1 - alpha_now, accuracy = 1),
              levels = c("95%", "80%")
            ),
            h = h_now,
            panel = paste0("h = ", h_now),
            age = parse_number(rownames(x)),
            observed = observed_matrix[, h_now],
            forecast = forecast_matrix[, h_now],
            lower = forecast_matrix[, h_now] - half_width,
            upper = forecast_matrix[, h_now] + half_width
          )
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(band_rows)
}

forecast_band_list <- list()

for (country in names(forecast_results)) {
  forecast_band_list[[country]] <- extract_forecast_bands(
    result = forecast_results[[country]],
    x = fertility_data[[country]]$smooth,
    observed_x = fertility_data[[country]]$raw,
    country = country
  )
}

forecast_band_data <- bind_rows(forecast_band_list) |>
  mutate(
    panel = factor(
      panel,
      levels = paste0("h = ", 1:10)
    )
  )
```

# France mortality analysis


## Mortality data and processing

```{r mortality-load-data}
france_demogdata <- demography::read.demogdata(
  file = "Empirical Study/Mortality Data/FRATNP_Mx_1x1.txt",
  popfile = "Empirical Study/Mortality Data/FRATNP_Exposures_1x1.txt",
  type = "mortality",
  label = "France"
) |>
  demography::extract.ages(0:95)

for (sex in c("female", "male")) {
  france_demogdata$rate[[sex]][
    france_demogdata$rate[[sex]] <= 0 |
      france_demogdata$rate[[sex]] > 1
  ] <- NA_real_

  for (age in seq_len(nrow(france_demogdata$rate[[sex]]))) {
    france_demogdata$rate[[sex]][age, ] <- imputeTS::na_interpolation(
      france_demogdata$rate[[sex]][age, ],
      option = "linear"
    )
  }
}

france_smoothed <- demography::smooth.demogdata(
  france_demogdata,
  method = "mspline",
  b = 65,
  weight = TRUE
)

keep_years <- france_demogdata$year >= 1901

mortality_data <- list(
  years = france_demogdata$year[keep_years],
  ages = france_demogdata$age,
  female_log = log10(
    france_demogdata$rate$female[, keep_years, drop = FALSE]
  ),
  male_log = log10(
    france_demogdata$rate$male[, keep_years, drop = FALSE]
  ),
  female_smooth_log = log10(
    france_smoothed$rate$female[, keep_years, drop = FALSE]
  ),
  male_smooth_log = log10(
    france_smoothed$rate$male[, keep_years, drop = FALSE]
  )
)

mortality_series <- list(
  Female = mortality_data$female_smooth_log,
  Male = mortality_data$male_smooth_log
)

mortality_raw_series <- list(
  Female = mortality_data$female_log,
  Male = mortality_data$male_log
)
```

## France mortality expanding-window forecast study

```{r mortality-run-models}
dir.create("Empirical Study/results", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

mortality_forecast_results <- list()

for (sex in names(mortality_series)) {
  result_path <- file.path(
    "Empirical Study/results",
    paste0("france_", tolower(sex), "_mortality_forecast.rds")
  )

  if (!params$rerun_models && file.exists(result_path)) {
    result <- readRDS(result_path)
  } else {
    result <- unified_pipeline(
      X = mortality_series[[sex]],
      X_eval = mortality_raw_series[[sex]],
      h_max = 10,
      train_ratio = 0.6,
      valid_ratio = 0.2,
      alpha_set = c(0.2, 0.05),
      window_types = "expanding",
      p_max = 5,
      q_max = 5,
      Npc = 1,
      B = 399,
      m_const = 0.75,
      far_pve = 0.95,
      fracdiff_trim = 20,
      seed = 123,
      far_benchmark_d = 1,
      order_selection_method = "both",
      cv_order_window_type = "expanding",
      memory_cov_type = "sample"
    )

    saveRDS(result, result_path)
  }

  mortality_forecast_results[[sex]] <- result
}

for (sex in names(mortality_forecast_results)) {
  benchmark <- mortality_forecast_results[[sex]]$error_detail |>
    filter(method == "far") |>
    arrange(order_selection_method, t0)

  ic <- benchmark |>
    filter(order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic")
  cv <- benchmark |>
    filter(order_selection_method == "cv_expanding")

  stopifnot(nrow(ic) == nrow(cv))
  stopifnot(identical(ic$t0, cv$t0))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ic))) {
    stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(ic$error[[i]], cv$error[[i]])))
  }
}
```

```{r mortality-selected-models}
    selected
  ) |>
    mutate(
      Method = as_method_factor(Method),
```

### Mortality metrics

```{r mortality-metrics}
mortality_metric_results <- list()

for (sex in names(mortality_forecast_results)) {
  result <- mortality_forecast_results[[sex]]
  point <- summarise_point_metrics(
    result,
    fitted_data = mortality_series[[sex]],
    observed_data = mortality_raw_series[[sex]]
  )
  interval <- summarise_interval_metrics_by_rule(
    result,
    fitted_data = mortality_series[[sex]],
    observed_data = mortality_raw_series[[sex]]
  ) |>
    mutate(Rule = factor(recode(as.character(Rule), grid_sd = "SR", scores = "NS", aci = "AC"), levels = c("SR", "NS", "AC"))) |>
    dplyr::select(Rule, Method, alpha, h, ECP, CPD, Score)
  wis <- bind_rows(
    summarise_wis(point, interval |> filter(Rule == "SR")) |> mutate(Rule = "SR", .before = 1),
    summarise_wis(point, interval |> filter(Rule == "NS")) |> mutate(Rule = "NS", .before = 1),
    summarise_wis(point, interval |> filter(Rule == "AC")) |> mutate(Rule = "AC", .before = 1)
  ) |>
    mutate(Rule = factor(Rule, levels = c("SR", "NS", "AC")))

  mortality_metric_results[[sex]] <- list(
    point = point,
    interval = interval,
    wis = wis
  )
}

mortality_point_metrics <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(mortality_metric_results), function(sex) {
    mortality_metric_results[[sex]]$point |>
      mutate(Sex = sex, .before = 1)
  })
)

mortality_interval_metrics <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(mortality_metric_results), function(sex) {
    mortality_metric_results[[sex]]$interval |>
      mutate(Sex = sex, .before = 1)
  })
)

mortality_wis_metrics <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(mortality_metric_results), function(sex) {
    mortality_metric_results[[sex]]$wis |>
      mutate(Sex = sex, .before = 1)
  })
)

mortality_point_ratios <- mortality_point_metrics |>
  left_join(
    mortality_point_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Sex, h, benchmark_RMSE = RMSE, benchmark_MAE = MAE),
    by = c("Sex", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    `RMSPE ratio` = RMSE / benchmark_RMSE,
    `MAPE ratio` = MAE / benchmark_MAE
  )

mortality_interval_ratios <- mortality_interval_metrics |>
  left_join(
    mortality_interval_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Sex, Rule, alpha, h, benchmark_Score = Score),
    by = c("Sex", "Rule", "alpha", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(`Score ratio` = Score / benchmark_Score)

mortality_wis_ratios <- mortality_wis_metrics |>
  left_join(
    mortality_wis_metrics |>
      filter(Method == "Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))") |>
      dplyr::select(Sex, Rule, h, benchmark_WIS = WIS),
    by = c("Sex", "Rule", "h")
  ) |>
  mutate(`WIS ratio` = WIS / benchmark_WIS)
```

```{r mortality-ratio-plots, fig.width=12, fig.height=7.5}
mortality_column_labels <- c(`Female 80%` = "80%", `Female 95%` = "95%", `Male 80%` = "80%", `Male 95%` = "95%")

merge_sex_strips <- function(p) {
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  strips <- g$layout[grepl("^strip-t", g$layout$name), ]
  strips <- strips[order(strips$l), ]
  top <- strips$t[1]
  g <- gtable::gtable_add_rows(g, g$heights[top], pos = top - 1)
  for (k in 1:2) {
    sex_strip <- ggplotGrob(ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, s = c("Female", "Male")[k]), aes(x, x)) + facet_wrap(~ s))
    g <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(g, sex_strip$grobs[[grep("^strip-t", sex_strip$layout$name)]], t = top, l = strips$l[2 * k - 1], r = strips$r[2 * k], name = paste0("strip-sex-", k))
  }
  g
}
```

# Comparing the interval calibration rules

```{r calibration-rule-comparison}
rule_metrics <- bind_rows(
  summarise_interval_metrics_by_rule(
    forecast_results[["England and Wales"]],
    fitted_data = fertility_data[["England and Wales"]]$smooth,
    observed_data = fertility_data[["England and Wales"]]$raw
  ) |>
    mutate(Dataset = "Fertility", .before = 1),
  bind_rows(lapply(names(mortality_forecast_results), function(sex_now) {
    summarise_interval_metrics_by_rule(
      mortality_forecast_results[[sex_now]],
      fitted_data = mortality_series[[sex_now]],
      observed_data = mortality_raw_series[[sex_now]]
    ) |>
      mutate(Dataset = paste("Mortality", sex_now), .before = 1)
  }))
) |>
  mutate(
    Dataset = factor(
      Dataset,
      levels = c("Fertility", "Mortality Female", "Mortality Male")
    )
  )

rule_labels <- c("Scaled residual", "Nonconformity", "ACI")

rule_comparison_table <- rule_metrics |>
  group_by(Dataset, Method, alpha, Rule) |>
  summarise(
    ECP = sum(covered) / sum(n),
    Score = sum(score_sum) / sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(CPD = abs(ECP - (1 - alpha))) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Rule,
    values_from = c(ECP, CPD, Score),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Rule}"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    `Interval level` = scales::percent(1 - alpha, accuracy = 1),
    Method = recode(
      as.character(Method),
      `Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))` = "Benchmark"
    ),
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Benchmark", "Functional IC", "CV")),
    across(starts_with(c("ECP_", "CPD_", "Score_")), ~ sprintf("%.4f", .))
  ) |>
  arrange(Dataset, desc(`Interval level`), Method) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Dataset,
    `Interval level`,
    Method,
    ECP_grid_sd, ECP_scores, ECP_aci,
    CPD_grid_sd, CPD_scores, CPD_aci,
    Score_grid_sd, Score_scores, Score_aci
  )

rule_comparison_table |>
  kable(
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    col.names = c("Dataset", "CP", "Method", rep(rule_labels, 3)),
    caption = paste(
      "Interval performance under the scaled residual band, nonconformity",
      "score and adaptive conformal rules, pooled over the ten forecast horizons"
    )
  ) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(
    c(" " = 3, "ECP" = 3, "CPD" = 3, "Score" = 3)
  ) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r calibration-rule-eta}
calibration_all <- bind_rows(

    attach_method() |>
    mutate(Dataset = "Fertility"),
  bind_rows(lapply(names(mortality_forecast_results), function(sex_now) {
    mortality_forecast_results[[sex_now]]$calibration_detail |>
      attach_method() |>
      mutate(Dataset = paste("Mortality", sex_now))
  }))
)

calibration_all |>
  distinct(Dataset, Method, alpha, aci_eta) |>
  mutate(
    `Interval level` = scales::percent(1 - alpha, accuracy = 1),
    Method = recode(
      as.character(Method),
      `Benchmark (FARFIMA(1,1,0))` = "Benchmark"
    ),
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Benchmark", "Functional IC", "CV"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Dataset, Method, `Interval level`, aci_eta) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Interval level`, values_from = aci_eta) |>
  arrange(Dataset, Method) |>
  kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "ACI learning rate selected on the validation period"
  ) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r calibration-rule-by-horizon}
rule_metrics |>
  filter(Method == "Functional IC") |>
  mutate(`Interval level` = scales::percent(1 - alpha, accuracy = 1)) |>
  dplyr::select(Dataset, `Interval level`, h, Rule, ECP, Score) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Rule,
    values_from = c(ECP, Score),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Rule}"
  ) |>
  arrange(Dataset, desc(`Interval level`), h) |>
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("ECP_", "Score_")), ~ sprintf("%.4f", .))) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Dataset, `Interval level`, h,
    ECP_grid_sd, ECP_scores, ECP_aci,
    Score_grid_sd, Score_scores, Score_aci
  ) |>
  kable(
    format = "html",
    col.names = c("Dataset", "CP", "h", rep(rule_labels, 2)),
    caption = "Functional IC interval performance by horizon under the three rules"
  ) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(" " = 3, "ECP" = 3, "Score" = 3)) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r calibration-rule-agreement}
multiplier_ratio <- unlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(calibration_all)), function(i) {
  (1 + 2 * calibration_all$Q_hat[[i]]) / calibration_all$zeta[[i]]
}))

rule_gap <- rule_metrics |>
  filter(Rule %in% c("grid_sd", "scores")) |>
  dplyr::select(Dataset, Method, alpha, h, Rule, ECP, Score) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Rule, values_from = c(ECP, Score)) |>
  mutate(
    ECP_gap = ECP_scores - ECP_grid_sd,
    Score_gap = Score_scores - Score_grid_sd
  )

tibble(
  Quantity = c(
    "cells compared",
    "multiplier ratio (1 + 2Q) / zeta, median",
    "multiplier ratio (1 + 2Q) / zeta, range",
    "max |ECP difference|",
    "max |Score difference|",
    "mean |Score difference|"
  ),
  Value = c(
    format(nrow(rule_gap)),
    sprintf("%.4f", median(multiplier_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf(
      "%.4f to %.4f",
      min(multiplier_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(multiplier_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    sprintf("%.4f", max(abs(rule_gap$ECP_gap), na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf("%.4f", max(abs(rule_gap$Score_gap), na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf("%.6f", mean(abs(rule_gap$Score_gap), na.rm = TRUE))
  )
) |>
  kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = paste(
      "Agreement between the scaled residual band and nonconformity",
      "score calibration rules"
    )
  ) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r calibration-rule-ecp-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
rule_coverage_plot_data <- rule_metrics |>
  mutate(
    `Interval level` = factor(
      ifelse(alpha == 0.2, "80%", "95%"),
      levels = c("80%", "95%")
    )
  )

rule_coverage_plot <- ggplot(
  rule_coverage_plot_data,
  aes(
    h, ECP,
    colour = Method,
    shape = Rule,
    linetype = Rule,
    group = interaction(Method, Rule)
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = 1 - alpha),
    colour = "#333333",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, stroke = 1) +
  facet_grid(Dataset ~ `Interval level`) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Forecasting method",
    values = method_palette,
    labels = method_plot_labels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "Calibration rule",
    values = c(grid_sd = 16, scores = 1, aci = 17),
    labels = c(
      grid_sd = "Scaled residual band",
      scores = "Nonconformity score",
      aci = "Adaptive conformal"
    )
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Calibration rule",
    values = c(grid_sd = "solid", scores = "22", aci = "4212"),
    labels = c(
      grid_sd = "Scaled residual band",
      scores = "Nonconformity score",
      aci = "Adaptive conformal"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0.50, 1.00, by = 0.05),
    labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.50, 1.00)) +
  labs(
    x = "Forecast horizon h",
    y = "ECP"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(shape = 16, linetype = "solid")),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(colour = "#333333")),
    linetype = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(colour = "#333333"))
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.box.just = "left"
  )

rule_coverage_plot

ggsave(
  "Empirical Study/Empirical Plots/Empirical_ecp_calibration_rules.pdf",
  rule_coverage_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 1200,
  bg = "white"
)
```
